# pve_ha_resource (Data Source)

Reads a single HA resource from `GET /cluster/ha/resources/{sid}`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

data "pve_ha_resource" "web" {
  sid = "vm:100"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `sid` (String) HA resource ID to look up, e.g. `vm:100` or `ct:101`.

### Read-Only

- `auto_rebalance` (Boolean) Whether the resource may be migrated during automatic rebalancing.
- `comment` (String) Description of the HA resource.
- `failback` (Boolean) Whether the resource migrates back to a higher-priority node when it comes online.
- `group` (String) HA group identifier constraining placement, when set.
- `max_relocate` (Number) Maximal number of relocate tries when a resource fails to start.
- `max_restart` (Number) Maximal number of restart tries on a node after a failed start.
- `state` (String) Requested resource state: `started`, `stopped`, `enabled`, `disabled`, or `ignored`.
- `type` (String) Resource type: `vm` or `ct`.
